function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

The phrase "國際象棋錦標賽" could refer to the Chess Olympiad or the World Chess Championship. But likely they mean the Chess Olympiad. The 2015 Chess Olympiad was held in Baku, Azerbaijan. The winners were Russia (team). But if they ask "who won?" maybe they refer to the team event. The top individual medalists: For gold medals: Vladimir Kramnik (Russia) got gold for best performance rating. But the question is ambiguous. Let's interpret as the Chess Olympiad. The winner was Russia. So answer: Russia. If they want the individual: Vladimir Kramnik. But I'll answer: Russia.
